diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
prevention: Provide adequate water, sunlight, and nutrients

diseases.name: Mosaic
symptoms: Irregular yellow or white patches on leaves
causes: Viral infection, often transmitted by whiteflies or aphids
treatments: No cure for viral infections in plants
Remove and destroy infected plants to prevent spread

diseases.name: Green mite
symptoms: Fine webbing on the underside of leaves
causes: Infestation by the green mite (Mononychellus spp.)
treatments: Use insecticidal soap or neem oil
prevention: Regularly inspect plants for early signs of infestation

diseases.name: Brown spot
symptoms: Circular to irregular brown spots on leaves
causes: Fungal infection often exacerbated by high humidity

diseases.name: Bacterial blight
causes: Bacterial infection, often enters through wounds or cuts
prevention: Properly sanitize tools to prevent spread
